data.body: Change 1423 (f161) round 1 of gate votes: LLM-Review +1 PASS (4 advisory), Verified -1. ROOT CAUSE = my own test, not a regression: test_shipped_contract_text_is_untouched ran 'git diff --exit-code origin/main -- <path>' and CI's checkout has no resolvable origin/main ref, so git exited 128 and the assertion reported 'was modified' when nothing was. Fixed by replacing the git dependency with a SHA256 digest of each site's contract-bearing lines (CONTRACT_DIGESTS), which tests the real invariant in any environment; verified it has teeth by tampering with one word of the E2 contract sentence (fails precisely). Also replaced a subprocess grep with a pure-Python walk - same environment-fragility class. Separately corrected an over-assertion: docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md is GENERATED and legitimately changes when any criterion is added, so byte-identity would have broken the moment ea28's T15 landed; only its contract SENTENCES are pinned now. Note my earlier prediction that CI would go red from the pre-existing grounding failure was WRONG for this run - the real cause was mine. Stack rebuilt (reset+amend+cherry-pick) preserving both Change-Ids; 1423/1424 updated in place. ea28 also implemented+validated: 16/16 incl 5 held-out, 3 mutations killed (routing tier downgrade, rubric execution_mode, dropped SCOPED CLEANUP check), first-attempt.
